Sorted, distinct codes, each a pure function of the same response
(``services/aggregate_metadata.py``).

AnalysisRunResponse.description: Provenance of the analysis pass that produced a summary / AI actions.

ChannelInspectionResponse.description:
Channel metadata, signal flags and trusted roles recorded at ingest (HOM-37).

Read-only and as stored: a later change of the workspace's channel-role
mapping does not change it.  Signal measures are a heuristic, not speech
detection; see ``backend/media/README.md``.

ChannelResultResponse.description: One channel: its signal measures and its role attribution (HOM-37).
ChannelResultResponse.title: ChannelResultResponse

ContentRedactionInfo.description:
How a summary, action item or evidence text was redacted (gap G10).

Present only when ``view == "redacted"``: the texts passed through the same
deterministic detector and classes as the transcript (placeholders share
the transcript's numbering).  It says nothing about identifiers the
detector does not cover (names, addresses) and nothing about the audio.

CoverageCounter.description:
One counter: a written definition, a numerator over a denominator, and
mutually exclusive buckets that sum to the denominator.
CoverageCounter.title: CoverageCounter

DispatchResponse.description: Outbox state of the job's broker publication (WP06-T02).
DispatchResponse.title: DispatchResponse

details.description: Optional structured context, for example validation fields.

EvidenceRefResponse.description: A finding's citation, embedded in the finding (WP04-T03).

EvidenceSpanResponse.description: A citation resolved to its immutable text and audio range.

IngestionResponse.description: One ledger row of the canonical ingestion contract (WP05-T01).
IngestionResponse.title: IngestionResponse

IngestionSourceType.description:
How audio enters Homayar (WP05-T01): the capture source of an ingestion.

Every capture provider (desktop, meeting bot, telephony, upload, watcher,
API) reports one of these; the adapter that delivered the event is the
``source_provider`` string next to it.  Only ``FILE_UPLOAD`` has a
producer today; the others are the canonical vocabulary later providers
must use instead of inventing their own ledger.

LeaseResponse.description: Execution ownership of the current/last attempt (WP06-T04).
LeaseResponse.title: LeaseResponse

MeetingQualityResponse.description: Quality, coverage and degradation of a meeting's results (WP04-T06).
MeetingQualityResponse.title: MeetingQualityResponse

OrganizationTrendBlock.description:
One cohort of an organization view.  A withheld cohort has no count at all:
``population``, ``coverage`` and ``missing_data`` are null, ``rows`` and ``points``
empty.
OrganizationTrendBlock.title: OrganizationTrendBlock

PopulationCoverage.description:
The ``coverage/1`` processing and evaluation counters over a population of rows
that is not the ledger (HOM-299, ADR 0041).  ``window.basis`` names the column the
window filters; ``basis`` names the population: the voicemail rows of

PopulationCoverageWindow.title: PopulationCoverageWindow

ReportCompleteness.description:
What is missing from a meeting's results: one rule for every read that
carries it (HOM-59, HOM-60).
ReportCompleteness.title: ReportCompleteness

StageRunResponse.description: Typed outcome of one processing stage (WP04-T01).
StageRunResponse.title: StageRunResponse

TeamComparison.description:
``compare_cells`` of two teams for one window row: left minus right, in the fixed
team order.  A difference, never a rank or a cause.
TeamComparison.title: TeamComparison

TranscriptFilters.description: The speaker and time filter a transcript response applied (HOM-60).
TranscriptFilters.title: TranscriptFilters

TranscriptRedactionInfo.description:
The redacted version a response was rendered from (WP07-T06).

``id`` is ``None`` when the version was computed for a share view (share
sessions never write); the texts are identical to the persisted version
of the same policy digest.
TranscriptRedactionInfo.title: TranscriptRedactionInfo

TranscriptRevisionResponse.description: Provenance of one immutable transcript revision (WP04-T02).
TranscriptRevisionResponse.title: TranscriptRevisionResponse

TrendCell.description:
``withheld`` (HOM-82): the counts are held back so that no hidden count of a small
group can be rebuilt; the denominator stays.
TrendCell.title: TrendCell

TrendCoverage.description:
The ``coverage/1`` processing and evaluation counters of the trend window (HOM-81).

``workspace``: the counters of ``GET /admin/coverage``.  ``trend_population``: the same
rules over the ledger rows whose meeting passes the caller's scope and the population
filters.

TrendDisclosure.description:

``masked`` layers are withheld (workspace views); ``withheld``: no count at all
(organization views).

The disclosure rules of the answer (HOM-82): a small group has fewer than

TrendFiltersResponse.description: The normalized filters; an empty list means no restriction.
TrendFiltersResponse.title: TrendFiltersResponse

TrendGrid.description: The fixed weekly grid of the organization views.
TrendGrid.title: TrendGrid

info.description:
Asynchronous ingestion API of Homayar, contract version 1.

**Auth.** Send an API key on every request: `Authorization: Bearer <api key>`.
A workspace admin creates keys in the console. A key acts in one workspace with
the scopes it was given: `meeting:create` to upload, `meeting:read` to read. A
revoked or expired key gets `401 api_key_invalid`. A missing scope gets
`403 api_key_scope_denied`. The cookie and CSRF parameters below belong to the
browser console; API clients do not send them.

**Flow.** 1) `POST /api/v1/uploads` (or `/api/v1/voicemails`) answers `202`
with the meeting and its processing job. 2) Poll
`GET /api/v1/meetings/{meeting_id}/job` until `state` is terminal: `completed`,
`failed`, `cancelled` or `dead_letter` (`queued` and `running` are not). 3) After
`completed`, read the results: `/transcript`, `/summary`, `/actions`,
`/evidence`, `/quality`, `/export`.

**Idempotency.** Every upload sends an `Idempotency-Key` header
(8 to 128 characters from `A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -`). The same key with the same
file and fields is a replay: `202` with the original job and
`idempotent_replay: true`, and no new job. The same key with a different
payload is `409 ingestion_conflict`. A malformed key is
`400 invalid_idempotency_key`. Keep the key when you retry, so a retry can never
create a second job.

**Role-scoped trend views (1.3.0).** Four read operations need a signed-in user
session and refuse every API key with `401 api_key_not_accepted`: the team comparison
`/api/v1/trends/teams`, the agent self-view `/api/v1/trends/me`, the executive aggregates
and the analyst drill-down under `/api/v1/organizations/{organization_id}`. Each cohort
carries a `disclosure` block; a cohort of 1 to 4 agents is held back.

**Supporting conversations (1.4.0).** `/api/v1/trends/conversations` lists the
conversations behind one `computed` cell of `/api/v1/trends/issues`, `/api/v1/trends/teams`
or `/api/v1/trends/me`, as ids only. It needs a signed-in user session too. Every trend
answer carries `notices: ["correlation_not_cause"]`: a trend shows how often an issue was
counted, not why.

**Aggregate metadata (1.5.0).** `/api/v1/voicemails/analytics` adds `coverage` (the
`coverage/1` processing and evaluation counters of the voicemails it counts), `scorecard`
and `missing_data`. Each item of `/api/v1/organizations/{organization_id}/aggregates` adds
the `coverage`, `scorecard`, `missing_data` and `disclosure` of the matching executive
trend block: a block of 1 to 4 agents in some closed week is withheld, with `coverage` and
`missing_data` null. Every existing field keeps its name and value.

**Channel inspection (1.6.0).** `GET /api/v1/meetings/{meeting_id}` adds
`channel_inspection`: the channel facts measured once at ingest (layout, sample rate, the
level of each channel, and the silent and duplicated flags) and a role per channel:
`agent`, `customer`, or `unknown` with a reason code. A role comes only from a workspace
admin's mapping for the recording's source, never from the upload request or the file. The
field is null for recordings ingested before this version. Every existing field keeps its
name and value.

**Aggregate counts follow the disclosure rule (1.7.0, breaking).** An owner-approved
breaking change of `/api/v1/organizations/{organization_id}/aggregates`. Before 1.7.0, each
item's `meetings_total`, `meetings_by_status`, `audio_seconds_total` and
`action_items_total` counted the live meetings by creation time in the free `since`/`until`
window (all time without one), and kept their values when the item was withheld. Since
1.7.0 they count the population of the item's trend block: the live meetings received
(ingestion `received_at`) in `coverage_window`, of the granted teams for a team grant. When
the item's `disclosure` is withheld, the four fields are null (the keys stay). `since` and
`until` are still echoed; they only choose `coverage_window`.

**Conversation fields (1.8.0).** Every meeting object (the `meeting` of an upload answer
and `GET /api/v1/meetings/{meeting_id}`) adds `conversation_type` (`call`, `meeting`,
`voicemail` or `other`), `direction` (`inbound`, `outbound`, `internal` or null),
`external_source_system` and `external_conversation_id` (the conversation's id in its
source system, both null or both set) and `started_at` (when it happened at the source, or
null). A voicemail is `voicemail`. Every existing field keeps its name and value.

**Errors.** Every error body is `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id",
"details"?}}`. `code` is stable; branch on it, not on `message`. Every response
carries `X-Request-ID`.

**Retries.** When a `429` or `503` carries `Retry-After` (seconds), wait at
least that long before the next attempt. A `429` without `Retry-After` is a
quota (`audio_quota_exceeded`, `concurrent_job_limit_reached`): waiting does
not help, so do not retry it. `502`, `503`, `504` and network errors are safe
to retry with backoff. Other `4xx` and `500` are not.
info.title: Homayar Ingestion API

get.description:
Counts per scoped workspace, and (HOM-299) each item's ``coverage``, ``scorecard``,
``missing_data`` and ``disclosure``: those of the executive view's block for the same
workspace, grant and window ``coverage_window`` (ADR 0041, L2).  A block HOM-82 withholds
is withheld here too.

HOM-320 (owner ruling B', a breaking change of contract 1.7.0): the counts are over the
block's population in ``coverage_window``: the live meetings received in it (ledger
``received_at``), of the granted teams for a team grant.  A withheld item's counts are
``null``.  ``since`` and ``until`` only choose ``coverage_window`` and are echoed.

Since 1.5.0. Who: an organization owner, admin, analyst or executive (`organization:analytics:read`), over the workspaces they may see. A signed-in session only: an API key is `401 api_key_not_accepted`. Each item adds `coverage`, `scorecard`, `missing_data` and `disclosure`: exactly those of the workspace block of `GET /api/v1/organizations/{organization_id}/trends/issues` for the same caller, grant and window. `coverage_window` is the window that `GET /api/v1/organizations/{organization_id}/trends/issues` would use for `from=since` and `to=until`, or its default (the 4 closed weeks before this week) when that route would refuse them. Since 1.7.0 (breaking): `meetings_total`, `meetings_by_status`, `audio_seconds_total` and `action_items_total` count the live meetings received (ingestion `received_at`) in `coverage_window`, of the granted teams for a team grant: the population of the same block. A withheld item has `coverage`, `missing_data` and these four fields null. `since` and `until` are echoed and only choose `coverage_window`.

get.description:
The conversations behind one cell of a workspace trend view (HOM-83).

Session only: every API key is ``401 api_key_not_accepted``.  Every workspace role with
``meeting:read`` may call it, inside its record scope.  ``trend_view`` is ``issues``,
``teams`` (exactly one ``team_id``, a team the caller may compare) or ``me``; the rest of
the query is that view's own, with ``from`` and ``to`` required.  ``row`` names the cell
(``family:<id>`` or ``issue:<id>``), ``point`` a point of the series, ``offset`` and
``limit`` (at most 100) the page.  Only a ``computed`` cell gives links: the
conversations of its numerator, by meeting id.  Every other cell is
``403 trend_links_withheld``.  A link holds ids only.

Since 1.4.0. Who: any workspace member with `meeting:read`, inside their record scope. A signed-in session only: an API key is `401 api_key_not_accepted`. `trend_view` is `issues`, `teams` (one `team_id` the caller may compare, else `403 team_scope_denied`) or `me`; the rest is that view's query, with `from` and `to` required (`422 trend_window_required`). `row` names the cell, `point` a point, `offset` and `limit` (at most 100) the page. Only a `computed` cell lists the conversations of its numerator, by meeting id; every other cell is `403 trend_links_withheld`. A link holds ids only, never text.

Supervisor team comparison (HOM-82): one block per team, compared in pairs.

Session only: every API key is ``401 api_key_not_accepted``.  Owners and admins
compare every active team (none: ``200`` with no team); members and viewers only the
active teams they supervise (``403 team_scope_denied`` otherwise, also for a ``team_id``
they may not compare).  At
most 10 teams (``422 trend_too_many_teams``).  ``agent_user_id`` is
``422 trend_parameter_not_allowed``.  A team is shown only when it is in the canonical
released set of the caller's scope.  No rank: teams in a fixed order by name.
